name: Kradak
description: The first Doyen and founder of Keld, who led the original Keldons from Parma and forged a bond with the Mountain.

description_citations.text: "Keld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The original Keldons come from Parma under Kradak to escape the cold.
timeline.quote: The original Keldons came over from Parma led by Kradak to escape the deadly cold of that land.

citation.text: "Keld", section "Founding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Keld is founded by the union of fire and hearth through Kradak's pact with Jezal.
timeline.quote: Thus Keld was founded by the union of fire and hearth.

citation.text: "Keld", section "Founding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor learns the foundation myths of Keld during his trial to become a warlord.
timeline.quote: as the Keldon runner Astor undergoes a trial to become a warlord

citation.text: "The Myths of Magic", section "Keldon Fire , by Scott McGough". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the peak Astor sees a vision of Kradak, who warns of the coming Keldon Twilight, and Astor becomes a warlord.
timeline.quote: Astor stood tall at the highest peak of Keld as a warlord

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Mountain". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Keld's first warlord, who appeared to Astor in a vision on the mountain's peak and warned of the Keldon Twilight.
